translations.literal: Ritual officers and announcers first led the censor, academicians, Director of the Grand Ancestral Temple, Director of the Imperial Kitchen, Chief Invokers, invoker-historians, vessel custodian, and officials bearing lei and baskets, entering by the south gate to between the steps, facing north in west-upper order, and had them stand in place.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officers and announcers first escorted the censor, academicians, Director of the Grand Ancestral Temple, Director of the Imperial Kitchen, Chief Invokers, invoker-historians, vessel custodian, and officials bearing lei and baskets through the south gate to between the steps, where they stood facing north in west-upper order.

sentences.zh: 奉禮曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The Ritual Gentleman said: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Gentleman said, "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」贊者承傳，皆再拜，訖，贊者引太祝與宮闈令，升自西階，詣始祖室，開祏室，太祝捧出帝主，宮闈令捧出後主，置於座。

translations.literal: The announcers received and relayed the announcement; all bowed twice; when finished, announcers led the Chief Invokers and Director of the Palace Enclosure up by the west steps to the founding ancestor's chamber, opened the spirit-tablet chamber; the Chief Invokers carried out the emperor's spirit tablet, the Director of the Palace Enclosure carried out the empress's spirit tablet, and they were set on their seats.
translations.idiomatic: The announcers relayed the command, and all bowed twice. When finished, announcers led the Chief Invokers and the Director of the Palace Enclosure up the west steps to the founding ancestor's chamber and opened the spirit-tablet chamber. The Chief Invokers carried out the emperor's spirit tablet, and the Director of the Palace Enclosure carried out the empress's spirit tablet and set them on their seats.

sentences.zh: 帝主在西，後主在東。

translations.literal: The emperor's spirit tablet was in the west; the empress's spirit tablet was in the east.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's spirit tablet was placed in the west; the empress's spirit tablet in the east.

sentences.zh: 贊者引太祝與宮闈令，降自西階，俱復位。

translations.literal: Announcers led the Chief Invokers and Director of the Palace Enclosure down by the west steps, and all returned to their positions.
translations.idiomatic: Announcers led the Chief Invokers and the Director of the Palace Enclosure down the west steps, and all returned to their positions.

sentences.zh: 奉禮曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The Ritual Gentleman said: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Gentleman said, "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」贊者承傳，在位官皆再拜，訖，俱各就執事位。

translations.literal: The announcers received and relayed the announcement; all officials in position bowed twice; when finished, all took up their ritual stations.
translations.idiomatic: The announcers relayed the command, and all officials in position bowed twice. When finished, all took up their ritual stations.

sentences.zh: 大樂令帥工人入。

translations.literal: The Director of Great Music led the musicians in.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Great Music led the musicians in.

sentences.zh: 禮直官、贊者分引三獻官與百官，俱自南東偏門入，至廟庭橫街上，三獻官當中，北向西上，應行事執事官並百官，依品，重行立。

translations.literal: Ritual officers and announcers separately led the three offering officers and all officials, all entering by the southeast side gate to the cross street in the temple courtyard; the three offering officers stood in the center, facing north in west-upper order; attending ritual officials and all officials, according to rank, stood in double rows.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officers and announcers separately escorted the three offering officers and all officials through the southeast side gate to the cross street in the temple courtyard. The three offering officers stood in the center facing north in west-upper order, while attending ritual officials and all other officials, according to rank, stood in double rows.

sentences.zh: 奉禮曰：「拜。

translations.literal: The Ritual Gentleman said: "Bow."
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Gentleman said, "Bow."

sentences.zh: 」贊者承傳，應北向在位官皆再拜。

translations.literal: The announcers received and relayed the announcement; all officials facing north in position bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The announcers relayed the command, and all officials facing north in position bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 其先拜者不拜。

translations.literal: Those who had already bowed did not bow again.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had already bowed did not bow again.

sentences.zh: 拜訖，贊者引三獻官詣廟殿東階下西向位，其餘行事執事官與百官，俱各就位。

translations.literal: When the bowing was finished, announcers led the three offering officers to the west-facing position below the east steps of the temple hall; the remaining attending ritual officials and all officials each took their positions.
translations.idiomatic: When the bowing was finished, announcers led the three offering officers to the west-facing position below the east steps of the temple hall. The remaining attending ritual officials and all other officials each took their positions.

sentences.zh: 訖，禮直官詣初獻官前，稱：「請行事。

translations.literal: When finished, the ritual officer went before the primary offerer and announced: "Please begin the rites."
translations.idiomatic: When all were in place, the ritual officer went before the primary offerer and announced, "Please begin the rites."

sentences.zh: 」協律郎跪，俯伏，興，樂作。

translations.literal: The pitch-master knelt, prostrated himself, rose, and the music began.
translations.idiomatic: The pitch-master knelt, prostrated himself, and rose; the music began.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引初獻詣盥洗位，北向立定，樂止。

translations.literal: The ritual officer led the primary offerer to the hand-washing station, had him stand facing north, and the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officer led the primary offerer to the hand-washing station and had him stand facing north; the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 搢笏，盥手，帨手，執笏。

translations.literal: He tucked in his tablet, washed his hands, dried his hands, and took up his tablet.
translations.idiomatic: He tucked in his tablet, washed his hands, dried them, and took up his tablet again.

sentences.zh: 詣爵洗位，北向立，搢笏，洗瓚，拭瓚，以瓚授執事者，執笏，升殿，樂作。

translations.literal: He proceeded to the cup-washing station, stood facing north, tucked in his tablet, washed the libation cup, wiped the libation cup, handed the cup to an attendant, took up his tablet, ascended the hall, and the music began.
translations.idiomatic: He proceeded to the cup-washing station and stood facing north. He tucked in his tablet, washed and wiped the libation cup, handed the cup to an attendant, took up his tablet again, and ascended the hall as the music began.

sentences.zh: 至始祖室尊彝所，西向立，樂止。

translations.literal: He reached the zun-yi station of the founding ancestor's chamber, stood facing west, and the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He reached the zun-yi station of the founding ancestor's chamber, stood facing west, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 執事者以瓚奉初獻官，初獻官搢笏，執瓚。

translations.literal: An attendant presented the libation cup to the primary offerer; the primary offerer tucked in his tablet and took the cup.
translations.idiomatic: An attendant presented the libation cup to the primary offerer, who tucked in his tablet and took the cup.

sentences.zh: 執尊者舉冪，太官令酌鬱鬯，訖，初獻以瓚授執事者，執笏，詣始祖室神位前，樂作，北向立，搢笏，跪。

translations.literal: The zun bearer raised the cover; the Director of the Imperial Kitchen poured the aromatic fermented liquor; when finished, the primary offerer handed the cup to an attendant, took up his tablet, proceeded before the spirit seat of the founding ancestor's chamber; the music began; he stood facing north, tucked in his tablet, and knelt.
translations.idiomatic: The zun bearer raised the cover, and the Director of the Imperial Kitchen poured the aromatic fermented liquor. When finished, the primary offerer handed the cup to an attendant and took up his tablet. He proceeded before the spirit seat in the founding ancestor's chamber as the music began, stood facing north, tucked in his tablet, and knelt.

sentences.zh: 執事者以瓚授初獻官。

translations.literal: An attendant handed the libation cup to the primary offerer.
translations.idiomatic: An attendant handed the libation cup to the primary offerer.

sentences.zh: 初獻官執瓚，以鬯稞地，訖，以瓚授執事者，執笏，俯伏，興，出戶外，北向，再拜，訖，樂止。

translations.literal: The primary offerer took the cup and poured the aromatic wine as a ground libation; when finished, he handed the cup to an attendant, took up his tablet, prostrated himself, rose, went out through the doorway, faced north, bowed twice; when finished, the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The primary offerer took the cup and poured the aromatic wine as a ground libation. When finished, he handed the cup to an attendant and took up his tablet. He prostrated himself, rose, went out through the doorway, faced north, and bowed twice; then the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 每室行禮，並如上儀。

translations.literal: The rites in each chamber were all performed according to the procedure above.
translations.idiomatic: The rites in each chamber were all performed according to the procedure described above.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引初獻降復位。

translations.literal: The ritual officer led the primary offerer down to return to his position.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officer led the primary offerer down to return to his position.

sentences.zh: 初獻將升稞，祝史各奉毛血肝惣豆，及齋郎奉爐炭蕭蒿黍稷篚，各於饌幔內以俟。

translations.literal: As the primary offerer was about to ascend for the libation, each invoker-historian bore the bean vessels of hair, blood, and liver offering, and offering-attendants bore baskets of brazier coals, artemisia, and millet, each waiting within the food pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: As the primary offerer was about to ascend for the libation, each invoker-historian carried the bean vessels of hair, blood, and liver offering, while offering-attendants carried baskets of brazier coals, artemisia, and millet, each waiting within the food pavilions.

sentences.zh: 初獻晨稞訖，以次入正門，升自太階。

translations.literal: Once the primary offerer had finished the morning libation, all entered in order through the main gate and ascended by the grand steps.
translations.idiomatic: Once the primary offerer had completed the morning libation, all entered in order through the main gate and ascended the grand steps.

sentences.zh: 諸太祝皆迎毛血肝惣豆於階上，俱入奠於神座前。

translations.literal: All the Chief Invokers received the bean vessels of hair, blood, and liver offering on the steps, all entered together, and set them before the spirit seats.
translations.idiomatic: On the steps, all the Chief Invokers received the bean vessels of hair, blood, and liver offering, entered together, and set them before the spirit seats.

sentences.zh: 齋郎所奉爐炭蕭蒿篚，皆置於室戶外之左，與祝史俱降自西階以出。

translations.literal: The baskets of brazier coals and artemisia borne by the offering-attendants were all placed to the left outside the chamber door; together with the invoker-historians they descended by the west steps and departed.
translations.idiomatic: The baskets of brazier coals and artemisia borne by the offering-attendants were placed to the left outside the chamber door. Together with the invoker-historians, they descended the west steps and departed.

sentences.zh: 諸太祝取肝惣，洗于鬱鬯，燔於爐炭，訖，還尊所。

translations.literal: The Chief Invokers took the liver offering, rinsed it in aromatic fermented liquor, burned it on the brazier coals; when finished, they returned to the ritual vessel station.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Invokers took the liver offering, rinsed it in aromatic fermented liquor, and burned it on the brazier coals. When finished, they returned to the ritual vessel station.

sentences.zh: 享日，有司設羊鼎十一、豕鼎十一於神廚，各在鑊右，初獻既升稞，光祿卿帥齋郎詣廚，以匕升羊於鑊，實於一鼎，肩、臂、臑、肫、胳、正脊一、橫脊一、長脅一、短脅一、代脅一，皆二骨以並。

translations.literal: On the day of the offering, the responsible officials set up eleven sheep cauldrons and eleven pig cauldrons in the divine kitchen, each to the right of a cooking pot; once the primary offerer had ascended for the libation, the Minister of Imperial Sacrifices led offering-attendants to the kitchen, used a spoon to lift the sheep from the pot into one cauldron—shoulder, upper leg, shank, gizzard, rib, one central spine, one cross spine, one long rib, one short rib, and one substitute rib, each with two bones joined together.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of the offering, the responsible officials set up eleven sheep cauldrons and eleven pig cauldrons in the divine kitchen, each to the right of a cooking pot. Once the primary offerer had ascended for the libation, the Minister of Imperial Sacrifices led offering-attendants to the kitchen and used a spoon to lift the sheep from the pot into one cauldron: shoulder, upper leg, shank, gizzard, rib, one central spine, one cross spine, one long rib, one short rib, and one substitute rib, each with two bones joined together.

sentences.zh: 次升豕如羊，實於一鼎。

translations.literal: Next the pig was lifted as with the sheep and placed in one cauldron.
translations.idiomatic: Next the pig was lifted in the same manner as the sheep and placed in one cauldron.

sentences.zh: 每室羊豕各一鼎，皆設扃冪。

translations.literal: Each chamber received one cauldron of sheep and one of pig; all were fitted with lids and covers.
translations.idiomatic: Each chamber received one cauldron of sheep and one of pig, each fitted with lid and cover.

sentences.zh: 齋郎對舉，入鑊，放饌幔前。

translations.literal: Offering-attendants lifted them in pairs, entered the cooking area, and set them before the food pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: Offering-attendants lifted the cauldrons in pairs, entered the cooking area, and set them before the food pavilions.

sentences.zh: 齋郎抽扃，委於鼎右，除冪，光祿卿帥太官令，以匕升羊，載於一俎。

translations.literal: Offering-attendants removed the lids and placed them to the right of the cauldrons, removed the covers; the Minister of Imperial Sacrifices led the Director of the Imperial Kitchen to lift the sheep with a spoon and load them onto one tray.
translations.idiomatic: Offering-attendants removed the lids and placed them to the right of the cauldrons, then removed the covers. The Minister of Imperial Sacrifices led the Director of the Imperial Kitchen to lift the sheep with a spoon and load them onto one tray.

sentences.zh: 肩臂臑在上端，肫胳在下端，脊脅在中。

translations.literal: Shoulder, upper leg, and shank at the upper end; gizzard and rib at the lower end; spine and ribs in the middle.
translations.idiomatic: The shoulder, upper leg, and shank were placed at the upper end; the gizzard and rib at the lower end; the spine and ribs in the middle.

sentences.zh: 次升豕如羊，各載於一俎。

translations.literal: Next the pig was lifted as with the sheep, each loaded onto one tray.
translations.idiomatic: Next the pig was lifted in the same manner as the sheep, each loaded onto one tray.

sentences.zh: 每室羊豕各一俎。

translations.literal: Each chamber received one tray of sheep and one of pig.
translations.idiomatic: Each chamber received one tray of sheep and one of pig.

sentences.zh: 齋郎既以扃舉鼎先退，置於神廚，訖，複還饌幔所。

translations.literal: Once the offering-attendants had lifted the cauldrons by their lids and withdrawn first, placing them in the divine kitchen, they returned to the food pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: Once the offering-attendants had lifted the cauldrons by their lids and withdrawn, placing them in the divine kitchen, they returned to the food pavilions.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引司徒出詣饌幔前，立以俟。

translations.literal: The ritual officer led the Minister over the Masses out to before the food pavilions, where he stood to await.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officer escorted the Minister over the Masses out to before the food pavilions, where he stood to await.

sentences.zh: 光祿卿帥其屬，實籩以粉餈，實豆以糝食，實簠以粱，實簋以稷。

translations.literal: The Minister of Imperial Sacrifices led his subordinates to fill baskets with pounded cakes, beans with mixed grain food, fang with millet, and gui with glutinous millet.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Imperial Sacrifices led his staff to fill baskets with pounded cakes, beans with mixed grain food, fang with millet, and gui with glutinous millet.

sentences.zh: 俟初獻稞畢，復位，祝史俱進徹毛血之豆，降自西階以出。

translations.literal: When the primary offerer had finished the libation and returned to his position, the invoker-historians together advanced and removed the bean vessels of hair and blood, descending by the west steps and departing.
translations.idiomatic: When the primary offerer had finished the libation and returned to his position, the invoker-historians together advanced to remove the bean vessels of hair and blood, then descended the west steps and departed.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引司徒，帥薦籩 豆簠簋官，奉俎齋郎，各奉籩豆簠簋羊豕俎，每室以序而進，立于南神門之外以俟，羊俎在前，豕俎次之，籩豆簠簋又次之。

translations.literal: The ritual officer led the Minister over the Masses, who in turn led the officers presenting baskets, beans, fang, and gui, and the tray-presenting offering-attendants; each bore baskets, beans, fang, gui, and sheep and pig trays, advancing in order chamber by chamber, and stood outside the South Spirit Gate to await—sheep trays first, pig trays next, baskets, beans, fang, and gui after that.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officer led the Minister over the Masses, who in turn led the officers presenting baskets, beans, fang, and gui and the tray-presenting offering-attendants. Each bore baskets, beans, fang, gui, and sheep and pig trays, advancing in order chamber by chamber, and stood outside the South Spirit Gate to await—sheep trays first, pig trays next, then baskets, beans, fang, and gui.

sentences.zh: 入自正門，樂作，升自太階，諸太祝迎引於階上，樂止。

translations.literal: They entered through the main gate; the music began; they ascended by the grand steps; the Chief Invokers received and led them on the steps; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: They entered through the main gate as the music began and ascended the grand steps. The Chief Invokers received and led them on the steps; then the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 各設於神位前，訖，禮直官引司徒以下，降自西階，樂作，復位，樂止。

translations.literal: Each was set before its spirit seat; when finished, the ritual officer led the Minister over the Masses and those below him down by the west steps; the music began; they returned to their positions; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Each offering was set before its spirit seat. When finished, the ritual officer led the Minister over the Masses and those below him down the west steps as the music began. They returned to their positions, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 諸太祝各取蕭蒿黍稷扌需於脂，燔於爐炭，還尊所。

translations.literal: Each Chief Invoker took artemisia and millet, moistened them in fat, burned them on the brazier coals, and returned to the ritual vessel station.
translations.idiomatic: Each Chief Invoker took artemisia and millet, moistened them in fat, burned them on the brazier coals, and returned to the ritual vessel station.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引初獻詣罍洗位，樂作，至位，北向立，樂止，搢笏，盥手，帨手，執笏。

translations.literal: The ritual officer led the primary offerer to the lei-washing station; the music began; upon reaching his position he stood facing north; the music stopped; he tucked in his tablet, washed his hands, dried his hands, and took up his tablet.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officer led the primary offerer to the lei-washing station as the music began. Upon reaching his position he stood facing north, and the music ceased. He tucked in his tablet, washed his hands, dried them, and took up his tablet again.

sentences.zh: 詣爵洗位，北向立，搢笏，洗爵，拭爵，以爵授執事者，執笏，升殿，樂作，詣始祖室酌尊所，西向立，樂止。

translations.literal: He proceeded to the cup-washing station, stood facing north, tucked in his tablet, washed the cup, wiped the cup, handed the cup to an attendant, took up his tablet, ascended the hall; the music began; he proceeded to the pouring station of the founding ancestor's chamber, stood facing west; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He proceeded to the cup-washing station and stood facing north. He tucked in his tablet, washed and wiped the cup, handed it to an attendant, and took up his tablet again. He ascended the hall as the music began, proceeded to the pouring station of the founding ancestor's chamber, stood facing west, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 執事者以爵授初獻。

translations.literal: An attendant handed the cup to the primary offerer.
translations.idiomatic: An attendant handed the cup to the primary offerer.

sentences.zh: 初獻搢笏執爵，執事者舉冪，太官令酌犧尊之泛齊，訖，次詣第二室酌尊所，如上儀。

translations.literal: The primary offerer tucked in his tablet and took the cup; an attendant raised the cover; the Director of the Imperial Kitchen poured the mild fermented wine from the sacrificial zun; when finished, he next proceeded to the pouring station of the second chamber, according to the procedure above.
translations.idiomatic: The primary offerer tucked in his tablet and took the cup. An attendant raised the cover, and the Director of the Imperial Kitchen poured the mild fermented wine from the sacrificial zun. When finished, he next proceeded to the pouring station of the second chamber according to the procedure described above.

sentences.zh: 詣始祖神位前，樂作，北向立，搢笏跪，執事者以爵授初獻，初獻執爵，三祭酒于茅苴，奠爵，執笏，俯伏，興，出室戶外，北向立，樂止。

translations.literal: He proceeded before the spirit seat of the founding ancestor; the music began; he stood facing north, tucked in his tablet, and knelt; an attendant handed the cup to the primary offerer; the primary offerer took the cup and poured three libations onto the thatched bundle, set down the cup, took up his tablet, prostrated himself, rose, went out through the chamber doorway, stood facing north; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He proceeded before the spirit seat of the founding ancestor as the music began, stood facing north, tucked in his tablet, and knelt. An attendant handed the cup to the primary offerer, who took it and poured three libations onto the thatched bundle, set down the cup, and took up his tablet. He prostrated himself, rose, went out through the chamber doorway, and stood facing north; then the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 贊者引太祝詣室戶外，東向，搢笏，跪讀祝文。

translations.literal: Announcers led the Chief Invoker to outside the chamber doorway; facing east, he tucked in his tablet, knelt, and read the prayer text.
translations.idiomatic: Announcers led the Chief Invoker to outside the chamber doorway. Facing east, he tucked in his tablet, knelt, and read the prayer text.

sentences.zh: 讀訖，執笏，興。

translations.literal: When the reading was finished, he took up his tablet and rose.
translations.idiomatic: When the reading was finished, he took up his tablet and rose.

sentences.zh: 次詣第二室。

translations.literal: Next he proceeded to the second chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Next he proceeded to the second chamber.

sentences.zh: 次詣每室行禮，並如上儀。

translations.literal: Next he proceeded to each chamber to perform the rites, all according to the procedure above.
translations.idiomatic: He then proceeded to each chamber in turn to perform the rites, all according to the procedure described above.

sentences.zh: 初獻降階，樂作，復位，樂止。

translations.literal: The primary offerer descended the steps; music began. He returned to his station, and the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The primary offerer descended the steps as music began, returned to his station, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 禮直官次引亞獻詣盥洗位，北向立，搢笏，盥手，帨手，執笏。

translations.literal: Next the ritual officer led the secondary offerer to the hand-washing station. He stood facing north, inserted his tablet, washed his hands, dried them, and took up his tablet again.
translations.idiomatic: Next the ritual officer led the secondary offerer to the hand-washing station. Facing north, he inserted his tablet, washed and dried his hands, and took up his tablet again.

sentences.zh: 詣爵洗位，北向立，搢笏，洗爵，拭爵以授執事官。

translations.literal: He proceeded to the cup-washing station, stood facing north, inserted his tablet, washed the cup, wiped it, and handed it to the attendant officer.
translations.idiomatic: He proceeded to the cup-washing station, stood facing north, inserted his tablet, washed and wiped the cup, and handed it to the attendant officer.

sentences.zh: 執笏，升殿，詣始祖酌尊所，西向立，執事者以爵授亞獻。

translations.literal: Holding his tablet, he ascended the hall and went to the libation station of the founding ancestor, where he stood facing west. The attendant officer handed the cup to the secondary offerer.
translations.idiomatic: Holding his tablet, he ascended the hall to the founding ancestor's libation station and stood facing west, where the attendant officer handed him the cup.

sentences.zh: 亞獻搢笏，執爵，執尊者舉冪，太官令酌象尊之醴齊，訖，次詣第二室酌尊所，如上儀。

translations.literal: The secondary offerer inserted his tablet and took the cup. The zun bearer raised the cover, and the Director of the Imperial Kitchen poured clear fermented liquor from the elephant zun. When finished, he next went to the libation station of the second chamber and performed the same rite.
translations.idiomatic: The secondary offerer inserted his tablet and took the cup. The zun bearer raised its cover while the Director of the Imperial Kitchen poured clear fermented liquor from the elephant zun. When finished, he proceeded to the second chamber's libation station and performed the same rite.

sentences.zh: 詣始祖神位前，樂作，北向立，搢笏，跪，執事者以爵授亞獻。

translations.literal: He went before the spirit seat of the founding ancestor. Music began. He stood facing north, inserted his tablet, knelt, and the attendant officer handed the cup to the secondary offerer.
translations.idiomatic: He went before the founding ancestor's spirit seat as music began, stood facing north, inserted his tablet, knelt, and received the cup from the attendant officer.

sentences.zh: 亞獻執爵，三祭酒于茅苴，尊爵，執笏，俯伏，興，出戶外，北向再拜，訖，樂止。

translations.literal: The secondary offerer took the cup and thrice poured libation onto the thatched bundle. He raised the cup, took up his tablet, prostrated himself, rose, went outside the door, and bowed twice facing north. When finished, the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The secondary offerer took the cup and thrice poured libation onto the thatched bundle, raised the cup, took up his tablet, prostrated himself, rose, went outside the door, and bowed twice facing north. When finished, the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 次詣每室行禮，並如上儀。

translations.literal: He next performed the rite at each chamber, all according to the procedure above.
translations.idiomatic: He next performed the rite at each chamber in the same manner.

sentences.zh: 降階，樂作，復位，樂止。

translations.literal: He descended the steps; music began. He returned to his station, and the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: He descended the steps as music began, returned to his station, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 禮直官次引終獻詣盥洗、及升殿行禮，並如亞獻之儀，降復位。

translations.literal: Next the ritual officer led the final offerer to hand-washing and up the hall to perform the rite, all according to the secondary offerer's procedure, then down to return to his station.
translations.idiomatic: Next the ritual officer led the final offerer through hand-washing and up the hall to perform the rite according to the secondary offerer's procedure, then back down to his station.

sentences.zh: 次引太祝徹籩豆少移故處，樂作，卒徹，樂止。

translations.literal: Next the Chief Invoker was led to remove the baskets and beans, shifting them slightly from their former places. Music began; when the removal was complete, the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Chief Invoker was led to remove the baskets and beans, shifting them slightly from their places. Music began, and when the removal was complete, the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 俱復位。

translations.literal: All returned to their stations.
translations.idiomatic: All returned to their stations.

sentences.zh: 禮直官曰：「賜胙。

translations.literal: The ritual officer announced: 'Sacrificial meat is granted.'
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officer announced, 'Sacrificial meat is granted.'

sentences.zh: 」贊者承傳曰：「賜胙，再拜。

translations.literal: The announcer transmitted: 'Sacrificial meat is granted. Bow twice.'
translations.idiomatic: The announcer transmitted, 'Sacrificial meat is granted. Bow twice.'

sentences.zh: 」在位者皆再拜。

translations.literal: All those in attendance bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: All those in attendance bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引太祝、宮闈令奉神主，太祝搢笏，納帝主於匱，奉入祏室，執笏，退復位。

translations.literal: The ritual officer led the Chief Invoker and the Director of Palace Environs to bear the spirit tablets. The Chief Invoker inserted his tablet, placed the senior tablet in its case, carried it into the spirit chamber, took up his tablet again, withdrew, and returned to his station.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officer led the Chief Invoker and the Director of Palace Environs to bear the spirit tablets. The Chief Invoker inserted his tablet, placed the senior tablet in its case, carried it into the spirit chamber, took up his tablet again, withdrew, and returned to his station.

sentences.zh: 次引宮闈令納後主於匱，奉入祏室，並如上儀，退復位。

translations.literal: Next the Director of Palace Environs was led to place the junior tablet in its case and carry it into the spirit chamber, all according to the procedure above, then withdraw and return to his station.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Director of Palace Environs was led to place the junior tablet in its case and carry it into the spirit chamber in the same manner, then withdraw and return to his station.

sentences.zh: 禮直官、贊者引行事、執事官各就位，奉禮曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The ritual officer and announcer led the officiants and attendant officers each to his station. The Ritual Gentleman announced: 'Bow twice.'
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officer and announcer led the officiants and attendant officers to their stations. The Ritual Gentleman announced, 'Bow twice.'

sentences.zh: 」贊者承傳，應在位官皆再拜。

translations.literal: The announcer transmitted the command, and all officers who should be in attendance bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer transmitted the command, and all officers in attendance bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 禮直官、贊者引百官次出，大樂令帥工人次出，太官令帥其屬，徹禮饌，次引監祭御史詣殿監視卒徹，訖，還齋所。

translations.literal: The ritual officer and announcer led the officials out in turn. The Minister of Ritual Music led the musicians out in turn. The Director of the Imperial Kitchen led his staff in removing the ritual provisions. Next the supervising censor was led to the hall to oversee the final removal. When finished, all returned to the fasting quarters.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officer and announcer led the officials out in turn, the Minister of Ritual Music led the musicians out, and the Director of the Imperial Kitchen led his staff in removing the ritual provisions. The supervising censor was then led to the hall to oversee the final removal, after which all returned to the fasting quarters.

sentences.zh: 太廟令闔戶以降。

translations.literal: The Director of the Grand Ancestral Temple closed the doors and descended.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Grand Ancestral Temple closed the doors and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 太常藏祝版於匱。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices stored the prayer boards in their cases.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices stored the prayer boards in their cases.

sentences.zh: 光祿以胙奉進，監祭御史就位展視，光祿卿望闕再拜，乃退。

translations.literal: The Imperial Sacrifices office presented the sacrificial meat. The supervising censor took his station and inspected it. The Minister of Imperial Sacrifices bowed twice toward the palace gate and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Sacrifices office presented the sacrificial meat. The supervising censor took his station and inspected it, and the Minister of Imperial Sacrifices bowed twice toward the palace gate before withdrawing.

sentences.zh: 其七祀，夏灶、中霤，秋門、厲，冬行，鋪設祭器，入實酒饌，俟終獻將升獻，獻官行禮，並讀祝文。

translations.literal: For the seven sacrifices—summer: the stove and central drain; autumn: the gate and spirit of pestilence; winter: the road—the sacrificial vessels were set out and filled with wine and food. When the final offerer was about to ascend and offer, the offering officers performed the rite and read the prayer text.
translations.idiomatic: For the seven sacrifices—summer: the stove and central drain; autumn: the gate and spirit of pestilence; winter: the road—the sacrificial vessels were set out and filled with wine and food. When the final offerer was about to ascend and offer, the offering officers performed the rite and read the prayer text.

sentences.zh: 每歲四孟月並臘五享，並如上儀。

translations.literal: Each year the five offerings in the four first months of the seasons, together with the la offering, all followed the procedure above.
translations.idiomatic: Each year the five offerings held in the four seasonal first months, together with the la offering, all followed the procedure described above.
